import sys, json, traceback, pathlib

idx=0
obs=None
def save(res, label=None):
    global idx, obs
    obs=res
    idx+=1
    p=f'/app/runs/{idx:03d}_{label or "obs"}'
    res.save(p)
    print('SAVED',p,flush=True)
    print(json.dumps(res.meta),flush=True)
    return res
def move(pos, quat=None, grip=0, label='move'):
    if quat is None: quat=[0,1,0,0]
    return save(r.submit('ee_pose',[list(pos)+list(quat)+[grip]],video='mp4',depth=True,note=label),label)
print('READY',flush=True)
save(r.get_obs(depth=True),'initial')
for line in sys.stdin:
    try:
        exec(line,globals())
    except Exception:
        traceback.print_exc()
    print('COMMAND_DONE',flush=True)
